business_outcome: Overall, Alibaba Cloud's Big Data solutions have enhanced Danamas by improving its operations and delivering superior service to its customers. The company has achieved faster and more efficient data processing and analysis, yielding valuable insights that have informed better business decisions. As the volume of Danamas's data continues to grow, the company is investigating various methods to adhere to its data retention policy while effectively monitoring its operational pipeline. evidence_quotes: As the data volume and business complexity grew in Danamas, it became increasingly challenging to get insights and analysis from that data.
Running regular queries for insights will take longer time and when done on existing resources will take operation resources from professional operators.
Danamas felt the need to create a single source of truth data warehouse on which they can effectively implement their data analysis.
Danamas also had plans to develop smart models on top of the analytics for which they needed a reliable and high performance data warehouse and big data analytics solution.
Before migrating to Alibaba Cloud, Danamas was using the production database to create dimensions and fact tables with an ETL solution.
